title: Selecting a Specialized AI Approach knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the central idea of “Selecting a Specialized AI Approach”?
options: Selecting a Specialized AI Approach focuses on Mapping a problem to an AI task; Identifying required inputs and outputs; Comparing data requirements. Define the terms used in the lesson, identify the assumptions that connect the inputs to the result, and use a small example to check whether the chosen approach fits the stated goal. AI specializations reuse shared foundations but...
It guarantees correct outcomes in every context and removes the need for independent evaluation.
It is always identical to a fixed if/then script, regardless of the data or task.
It can be trusted solely because its output is fluent or its internal score is high.
questions.answer_key: Selecting a Specialized AI Approach focuses on Mapping a problem to an AI task; Identifying required inputs and outputs; Comparing data requirements. Define the terms used in the lesson, identify the assumptions that connect the inputs to the result, and use a small example to check whether the chosen approach fits the stated goal. AI specializations reuse shared foundations but...
questions.explanation: The lesson defines the topic this way: Selecting a Specialized AI Approach focuses on Mapping a problem to an AI task; Identifying required inputs and outputs; Comparing data requirements. Define the terms used in the lesson, identify the assumptions that connect the inputs to the result, and use a small example to check whether the chosen approach fits the stated goal. AI specializations reuse shared foundations but... The distractors claim guarantees or equivalences that are not supported by the curriculum.

questions.prompt: When applying “Selecting a Specialized AI Approach” to a new problem, which practice is the strongest default?
options: Skip evaluation when the first demonstration looks convincing.
Use a small, representative test set, compare against an explicit baseline, inspect errors, and document assumptions.
Tune all decisions directly on the final test examples until the score improves.
Assume a method that worked once will work on every population and input distribution.
questions.answer_key: Use a small, representative test set, compare against an explicit baseline, inspect errors, and document assumptions.
questions.explanation: Use a small, representative test set, compare against an explicit baseline, inspect errors, and document assumptions. This practice makes assumptions visible and gives a reviewer evidence beyond one convincing demonstration.

questions.prompt: Which conclusion is appropriately cautious after a system demonstrates “Selecting a Specialized AI Approach”?
options: The system has proven its result is unbiased and safe for every use.
A successful example removes the need for monitoring or documentation.
No. Check uncertainty, context, data quality, security, and affected users; report limitations and use human oversight appropriate to the impact.
Any numeric score or generated explanation is a guarantee of factual correctness.
questions.answer_key: No. Check uncertainty, context, data quality, security, and affected users; report limitations and use human oversight appropriate to the impact.
questions.explanation: Observed performance is conditional on the test conditions. Review uncertainty, context, risks, and failures before deciding how the system may be used.
